toyData: All sample counts, identities, timing, proportions and area geometry invented; not Diana data or thresholds
altText: A schematic pretend pretreatment section distinguishes excluded malignant nests and eligible stroma inside invasive-tumor borders. Separate invented area blocks show region A with four equal units of eligible stroma and 0.4 units occupied by infiltrate, and B with one equal unit of stroma and 0.6 occupied units. At the same scale, the pooled-area fraction is 1/5, or 20%; the unweighted regional mean is 35%. Area, not cell count, is the denominator. This toy geometry is not a mandated pixel workflow; pretreatment and residual-bed methods remain distinct.
caption: With invented eligible areas of four and one units, pooling occupied area gives 20%; an unweighted 35% mean gives the smaller region too much weight.
